items.name: ReadOptions
items.summary: Options for a basic (DataFusion-free) read. Richer predicate/projection pushdown is the DataFusion extension's job ([`datafusion_ext::DeltaDataReaderExt`]).

methods.name: with_limit
methods.summary: Limit the number of rows returned.

methods.name: with_projection
methods.signature: fn with_projection(self, projection: impl Into<Vec<String>>) -> Self
methods.summary: Project to the given logical column names.

items.name: DataFileReader
items.summary: File tier: reads a single parquet data file (the per-file decryption seam, mirroring [`DataFileWriter`]). Impl: [`reader::ParquetFileReader`].

methods.name: read_file
methods.signature: async fn read_file(&self, path: object_store::path::Path) -> DeltaResult<BatchStream>
methods.summary: Read the parquet data file at `path` into a stream of record batches.

items.name: DataFileWriter
items.summary: File tier: writes a single Delta data file (or size-split set for one partition). The per-file seam where parquet `WriterProperties`/encryption attach. Impl: [`writer::PartitionWriter`].

methods.name: abort
methods.summary: Abandon the writer after an error, aborting its in-progress multipart uploads. Dropping the writer instead leaks upload parts vacuum cannot see, and `close`-ing it finalizes files for partially-written data; error-path callers should use t…

methods.name: close
methods.summary: Finish writing and return the uncommitted [`Add`] actions for the files that were produced.

methods.name: write
methods.signature: async fn write(&mut self, batch: &RecordBatch) -> DeltaResult<()>
methods.summary: Buffer a record batch, writing to one or more parquet files as needed. The batch must match the writer's (partition-stripped) file schema.

items.name: DeltaDataReader
items.summary: Dataset tier: a DataFusion-free reader that composes the file tier ([`DataFileReader`]) across a table's data files, applying deletion vectors, partition values, and column-mapping transforms.

methods.name: read
methods.signature: async fn read(&self, options: ReadOptions) -> DeltaResult<BatchStream>
methods.summary: Read the selected data as a batch stream.

items.name: DeltaDataWriter
items.summary: Dataset tier: a DataFusion-free writer that drains a batch stream into a table's data files (partitioning and composing a [`DataFileWriter`] per partition). Batches must already conform to the table schema and constraints (callers on the b…

methods.name: write_all
methods.signature: async fn write_all(Box<self>, batches: BatchStream) -> DeltaResult<Vec<Add>>
methods.summary: Drain the batch stream into data files, returning the uncommitted [`Add`] actions (still to be committed via a transaction).

items.name: BatchStream
items.summary: A fallible stream of [`RecordBatch`]es — the common currency of both tiers. Producers that parallelize (concurrent file opens, partitioned scans) do so upstream and merge into this stream.
